GEN3D_ENABLE_REAL_PROVIDERS.description: Master switch. "1" enables real provider calls; "0" forces the quota-safe mock path.

HUNYUAN_API_KEY.description: Hunyuan workflow API key (Bearer). Empty string clears it.

HUNYUAN_BASE_URL.description: Hunyuan workflow base URL (address, not a secret). Empty string clears it.

MESHY_API_KEY.description: Meshy API key. Empty string clears it.

RODIN_API_KEY.description: Rodin (Hyper3D) API key. Empty string clears it.

slug.description: Active game slug auto-injected by the workbench host into every tool call; not a credential and ignored by this tool (dropped by the CRED_KEYS whitelist).
